name: discuss_start
description: Open a multi-session discussion room as host: send the round-1 brief to each member session's talk inbox and report who is live vs inactive. Returns the room name for discuss_collect/broadcast/end. Pass exactly one of members (existing session ids) or member_count (auto-spawned sessions owned by this room); counts are integers.

topic.description: The question to argue (e.g. 'tabs vs spaces').

members.description: 1-8 existing member session ids from session_list; must exist and cannot include the host. Either this or member_count.

member_count.description: Whole number of member sessions to auto-spawn (1-8, e.g. 2). Fresh ids embed the room name; their databases are created by their own processes. Either this or members.

roles.description: Optional stance per member, positionally aligned (one per member, or empty for none). Without roles, auto-spawned members default to pro/contra/judge/independent stances; explicit members get no stance.

max_rounds.description: Whole number of rounds before forced close (default 3).

room.description: Optional room name (1-64 chars); auto-generated when omitted.
